works.title: Economic Knowledge Reference Reports
works.description: A series of numbered economic reference reports and guides covering critical economic measurement and knowledge topics. Includes Report 1.3 on labor market measurement (BLS unemployment measures, participation rates, employment indicators) and Report 3.7 on source credibility hierarchy in economic reporting, with systematic coverage of statistical sources and their appropriate use.
works.quote: Produce a comprehensive reference report on labor market measurement covering every significant indicator published by official sources

works.title: Physics Paper: Wobble Model and Quantum Phenomena
works.description: A physics paper or research outline exploring wobble models as an alternative framework for understanding quantum mechanics. The user is integrating thought experiments (such as off-center weighted golf ball/billiard ball analogies) into an existing physics outline to test whether the wobble model can explain quantum behaviors without wave-particle duality.
works.quote: I want you to understand the outline in the first paste... Sort out ideas from that thread for a thought experiment that builds on ideas in the first pasted outline
